component.name: Theme Hub
component.summary: Handcrafted desktop themes and look-and-feel switcher for Linux

description.p: Theme Hub is a unified appearance switcher for Linux supporting GNOME and KDE Plasma. It enables instant switching between four distinct desktop themes with a single click:

ul.li: Modern Aesthetic: Dark minimalist look with Inter fonts, Tela Circle icons, and floating dock.
Windows 11: Authentic Windows 11 style with Fluent icons, centered taskbar, and Bloom wallpaper.
macOS Sonoma: Sonoma 4K wallpapers, WhiteSur icons, traffic-light controls on left, and dock.
Original Stock: Clean, safe, one-click restoration of default system settings.
